name: Black Bean Burger with Guacamole & Side Salad

instructions: Pan-crisp the black bean patty per package, 4-5 minutes per side.
Serve open-faced on toast, topped with guacamole.
Toss spinach and tomato with olive oil for the side.
Serve with smartwater, vapor distilled (355 g).
